question: The tube moves forward; the O spins forward too. How fast does it pass?
answer: The O spins the way the tube moves, so its speeds add and it passes faster than the tube. The X spins backwards, so it is slower. Pick one, then watch the arrows add up.
move: On a spinning, moving object, spin adds on one side and subtracts on the other.

web.label: A tube moves forward while an O and an X spin on it. The reader picks whether the O passes faster, slower, or at the same speed as the tube, then watches arrows show the speeds adding up.
